_doc: The Rhodes velocity map (rhodes.c rh_vm, tools/gen_velmap.py -> firmware/gen/rh_velmap.h). Per key: the bark (H2..H5 re H1, 30-150 ms) flat at flat_db up to the knee velocity, then slope_db_per_vel above it, a soft hinge of width hinge_w (the 10-90 % corner is 4.39 w velocity steps); a knee >= 127 is no rise. The fundamental (H1, 30-300 ms) follows the engine's own curve up to v64 and above it rises h1_top_db more to v127 on a saturating curve (time constant h1_sat_tau velocity steps), blended to the engine's own (linear in dB) curve by h1_linear (0 .. 1). Points are [key, value], linear in between, the end values held.
